Off Calendar Jul-30-2026 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES:

No appearances. The Court adopts the tentative ruling as follows:

PLAINTIFF MADISON LAIRD'S, INDIVIDUALLY, AND ON BEHALF OF ALL OTHERS SIMILARLY SITUATED, Renewed Motion For Dismissal Of Entire Action.

Plaintiff Madison Laird's unopposed Renewed Motion For Dismissal Of Entire Action is GRANTED.

Good cause appearing consistent with Code of Civil Procedure 581(b), Labor Code section 2699 and California Rules of Court, rule 3.770, the court orders that Plaintiff may dismiss his individual claims with prejudice, his representative PAGA claims without prejudice and his class allegations and claims without prejudice, resulting in dismissal of the entire action.

Plaintiff must file a request for dismissal on the Judicial Council form and may include a copy of this order with that submission.

Plaintiff is ordered to prepare a proposed order consistent with the above and email it to contestdept302tr@sftc.org prior to the time set for hearing.

Order is signed.

Judge: Joseph M. Quinn, Clerk: M. Goodman, Not Reported. (302/JMQ)
